templates.subject: Your {month} Corvid Card statement
templates.text:
New credit card statement

We’ve added your latest statement to the Corvid app.

Card: Corvid credit card ending 0938
Statement date: {date}
Statement balance: {balance}

Open Statements to check your transactions, minimum payment and payment due date. If you pay by Direct Debit, leave it active and we'll collect the amount shown in the app.

View your statement: https://corvidcard.example/account/statements

You're receiving this service email because you hold a Corvid credit card. Replies to this address are not monitored.

Corvid Card Services Ltd, 6 Rook Place, Leeds LS1 4DL. Registered in England and Wales.

templates.subject: Your {month} statement and a payment reminder
templates.text:
Your payment is due in five days

Your latest statement is ready. There’s also a payment due on the 23rd for your previous statement.

Card: Corvid credit card ending 0938
New statement date: {date}

Check Payments in the app for the amount still due on the previous statement. If you've recently scheduled a payment, it may take up to two working days to show.

Open card account: https://corvidcard.example/account/payments
